pages.text: Something Is Here
pages.subtext: The Star Door Mystery
pages.alt: Mira, Tavi, Sol and Nori gather in the star room near the shut Star Door, a parcel and a map with five stars.

pages.alt: Mira, Tavi and Sol stand in the library beside the empty map stand.

pages.text:
Before breakfast, Mira, Sol and Tavi met in the star room.

The Star Door was shut.
pages.subtext: It had a letter box. A parcel sat on the other side of the room.
pages.alt: Mira, Tavi and Sol face the shut Star Door in the star room.

pages.text: A note slid through the letter box and landed beside Mira’s boots.
pages.subtext: Mira bent down, picked up the note and opened it.
pages.alt: A note lies beside Mira's boots after coming through the Star Door's letter box.

pages.text:
“I found a note!” said Mira. She read it aloud:

FIND NOTHING.
FIVE CLUES WILL SHOW THE WAY.
pages.subtext: Sol said, “That sounds very strange—and a little funny. Let’s see what the clues show us!” A tiny optional book code is hiding in the room.
pages.alt: Mira holds the open written note where Sol and Tavi can see it. The optional code ROOMSTAR is hidden in the scene.

pages.text:
A map lit up above the door. It showed five star shapes with no gold inside them.

“Each clue we finish will fill one star,” said Mira.
pages.subtext: The first gold arrow pointed to the parcel. Trace the arrow with your finger.
pages.alt: Mira holds the note below a map with five outlined stars and one bright arrow pointing to the shut parcel.

pages.text:
The friends followed the arrow. Sol opened the parcel.

His brown teddy was inside. “There is my toy!” he said.

Lift the teddy out and put it beside the box.
pages.subtext: Move the toy before you turn the page.
pages.alt: The parcel is open and Sol's brown teddy is clearly visible inside the box.

pages.text:
The teddy now sat beside the parcel. Sol looked into the box.

“The toy is outside now. What is inside the box?”
pages.subtext: Point to everything that is still here before you turn.
pages.alt: The teddy sits beside the open box. The child can see inside the box.

pages.text:
TEDDY OUTSIDE.
BOX STILL HERE.

“The box is empty,” said Tavi. “Empty means there is no toy inside this box. The box is still here.”
pages.subtext: The first star filled with gold. Find the hidden optional code.
pages.alt: The open empty box and the teddy outside are clearly labelled while the first map star glows gold.

pages.text:
The box was empty, but it was still a box. They had not found a thing called nothing.

The first star made a blue door swing open. Nori was waiting beside three big bells.
pages.subtext: “Hello! I’m Nori. I listen for tiny sounds. May I help?”
pages.alt: Mira, Tavi and Sol enter a room with bells and meet Nori, the new friend in this adventure.

pages.text:
The wind stopped. The biggest bell became still.

Nori stood beside it. “Cup your hand to your ear. Let’s be very quiet and listen.”
pages.subtext: What can you hear? Listen before you turn.
pages.alt: Nori and the three friends listen beside a big bell that is not moving.

pages.text:
“The bell did not ring while we listened,” said Nori.

“I heard my breath. The quiet bell was still here.”
pages.subtext: The second star filled with gold. Find the optional code.
pages.alt: Nori listens beside the still bell while the second star glows.

pages.text:
The second star made another door open. It led to a room full of paper.

Mira picked up a white card from the round table. The card had no marks on it yet.
pages.subtext: A thick pencil lay beside the card.
pages.alt: Mira holds a white card with no marks above a round table while Tavi, Sol and Nori look.

pages.text:
Use your finger in the air.

Pretend to draw a mark—or leave the card with no marks.

What is still there in both choices?
pages.subtext: You can choose either one. Choose before you turn.
pages.alt: A white card and a pencil are ready. The child can pretend to draw a mark or leave the card blank.

pages.text:
MARK AND CARD HERE—or BLANK CARD HERE.

Blank means there is no mark on this card. The card is still here either way.
pages.subtext: The third star lit. Find the hidden optional code.
pages.alt: One white card has a mark and another is blank. Both cards are labelled while star three glows.

pages.text:
The card was still there, so the third star filled with gold.

Seven tiles on the wall lit up, one after another. Each tile showed one letter.
pages.subtext: Sol pointed to the first tile. “Read them from left to right with me!”
pages.alt: Mira, Tavi, Sol and Nori look up as seven wall tiles light up from left to right.

pages.text:
Point to each tile from left to right:

N   O   T   H   I   N   G
pages.subtext: Say each letter, then say the whole word.
pages.alt: Seven large labelled tiles spell N O T H I N G from left to right above the four friends.

pages.text:
“The seven letters spell the word nothing,” said Tavi.

“We can see and read it. Nothing is the word on the tiles. It is a word, not a thing.”
pages.subtext: The fourth star filled with gold.
pages.alt: The seven letter tiles still spell NOTHING while Mira, Tavi, Sol and Nori watch the fourth star glow.

pages.text:
The fourth star opened a hallway with a red curtain.

As Sol walked in, his teddy rolled out of his bag. It crossed the floor and stopped behind the open curtain.
pages.subtext: Everyone saw where the teddy went.
pages.alt: Everyone watches Sol's teddy roll across the floor and stop behind the open red curtain.

pages.text:
Nori closed the red curtain. Now the curtain blocked the teddy, so no one could see it.

“I saw where it went,” said Sol. “Is it still there?”
pages.subtext: Remember where the teddy stopped. Decide before you turn.
pages.alt: The red curtain is closed and blocks the teddy while Mira, Tavi, Sol and Nori remain visible.

pages.text:
Mira opened the curtain. “There is the teddy!”

“The teddy was hidden,” she said. “Hidden means it was there, but the curtain stopped us seeing it.”
pages.subtext: The teddy did not disappear. The fifth star filled with gold. Find the optional code.
pages.alt: The red curtain is open and Sol's teddy is visible again beside all four friends while star five glows.

pages.text:
The teddy was still there, so the fifth star filled with gold.

All five stars began to turn. The Star Door opened with a long WHOOSH.
pages.subtext: Finishing all five clues made the door open.
pages.alt: All five stars glow as the Star Door opens in front of Mira, Tavi, Sol and Nori.

pages.text:
Behind the Star Door were two small doors.

Door A had a white card on its shelf. Door B had an empty shelf.

Which door showed nothing?
pages.subtext: Look behind both doors before you decide.
pages.alt: Door A shows a white card. Door B shows an empty shelf.

pages.text:
Door A showed a card.

Door B showed an empty shelf.

Mira asked, “Did either door show a thing called nothing?”
pages.subtext: Only use what you can see behind the doors.
pages.alt: Door A shows a card. Door B shows an empty shelf.

pages.text:
“Door A showed a card. Door B showed an empty shelf,” said Tavi.

“Neither door showed a thing called nothing.”
pages.subtext: The note’s puzzle is solved. Find the final hidden optional code.
pages.alt: Mira, Tavi, Sol and Nori stand between both small doors while the optional code TWODOORS hides near the map.

pages.text:
Mira opened the same note and read it again:
FIND NOTHING.

They found a box, a quiet bell, a card, a written word and a hidden teddy—but no thing called nothing.
pages.subtext: Nothing was not a thing they could find.
pages.alt: Mira holds the note beside the five-star map while Tavi, Sol and Nori listen.

pages.text:
The friends carried the map into the library.

Tavi asked, “Which thing became empty after you moved Sol’s teddy outside?”
pages.subtext: Choose between the open box and the teddy. Think before you turn.
pages.alt: Tavi asks the question while the open box and teddy stay as two clear choices.

pages.text:
EMPTY BOX.
TEDDY OUTSIDE.

The box became empty after the teddy moved outside, but the box stayed in the room.
pages.subtext: Remember means bringing an earlier clue back to mind.
pages.alt: The open box and teddy outside are clearly labelled in the library while the four friends remember the first clue.

pages.text:
Mira folded the note and put the finished map in its library stand.

“Now we can tell the whole story again,” she said.
pages.subtext: The first adventure is complete.
pages.alt: Mira puts the five-star map into the library stand while Tavi, Sol and Nori watch.

pages.text:
1. LOOK: What can you see or hear?
2. SAY: What changed?
3. CHECK: Does your answer match what you found?

Can you tell one clue again?
pages.subtext: Tavi can ask how you checked, but will not tell you a new answer.
pages.alt: Tavi shows three picture cards for look, say and check. The finished map is beside them.

pages.text:
CHIME!

A little door opened high in the library wall. A blue-and-gold parcel slid down a ramp and stopped beside Sol.
pages.subtext: Sol grinned. “Our first mystery is finished. Is this the next one?”
pages.alt: A blue-and-gold parcel has slid down a wall ramp and stopped beside Sol while Mira, Tavi and Nori notice it.

pages.text:
Mira read the parcel label aloud:

HOW CAN ONE WHOLE HAVE MANY PARTS?
pages.subtext: Next: Book E02 · One Whole, Many Parts
pages.alt: Mira reads the large parcel label to Tavi, Sol and Nori in the sunrise library.
